note: Ambient traffic by REGION (user, 2026-10-10): which vehicles drive there and how much of the car budget the region gets. A region is a box of the places record (world.Places.regionAt, the same boxes the buildings were placed by); its row here is the one whose key is the longest PREFIX of the region's name ('residential_north' -> 'residential', 'light_industry_w' -> 'light_industry'), else `default`. `mix`: catalog vehicle id -> weight (any positive numbers; a car is drawn in proportion). `scale`: the share of ZoneManager.trafficBudget kept while the busiest player stands in that region (1 = all of it). Used by the simulated cars (host-decided, the same for every peer) and by the far tier's placeholder cars (local). MOTORCYCLES (PLAN.md 3.1b, 2026-10-16): SCT1 scooter / POB1 postal Cub / SSB1 supersport / TRB1 trail are civilian traffic like any car and take a car's slot of the budget (a bike is a full body + a seated rider, a car's cost); PMB1 (白バイ) is police-only. Their weights here are UNREVIEWED picks (~8-12 % of a row; the farm trail bikes, the city scooters).
